name: escalation-writer

fragments.text: This summary goes to the sales director. Give them what they need to act fast, including money at stake. Flag credit exposure: note whether the claim came in within the usual 48-hour window after delivery, remember that credits are worked out per bad crate rather than across the whole load, and call it out loudly when the amount looks big enough to need the director's sign-off (larger credits can't just be handed out). Do not promise the contact a figure — that is the director's call after checking the delivery record and inspection report.
